prompt.name: Spearman
prompt.look: An ancient-to-medieval foot soldier: a friendly adult man with a prominent nose, brown eyes, strong eyebrows and a full dark-brown beard, medium-length brown hair under a rounded stitched brown leather cap, a muscular, slightly stylised build with a large head and hands, a short tunic to mid-thigh and a short cloak fastened with a round bronze clasp, a brown leather belt with a brass buckle and a hanging leather tab, bare forearms and lower legs, calf-high brown leather boots with wraps, a long straight wooden spear with a silver-grey head, and a round wooden shield with vertical grain, a dark metal rim, rivets and a raised silver-grey boss.
prompt.identity: the same face and beard, cap, red tunic and cloak, belt, boots, spear and shield
prompt.weapon_pose: He holds the spear upright in his right hand (on the left of the image), its butt end on the ground a hand's width clear of his boots. The round shield is on his left arm and its lower edge ends above the hem of his tunic.
prompt.attack: (1) ready stance; (2) anticipation: knees bent, weight shifting back; (3) wind-up: spear drawn far back and up; (4) fast forward lunge, spear half-extended; (5) full extension: spear fully extended to the right, front knee deeply bent, cloak streaming back; (6) recover to the ready stance.
prompt.damage_gear_critical: a chipped shield and a bent spear
prompt.defeat_prop: the spear planted upright beside him

states.note: walk built in code from the idle drawing; the legs alternate by construction
